blocks.title: Instantaneous rate
blocks.text: Kisi waqfe (interval) ke dauran kisi ek lamhe ki rate ko instantaneous rate (lamhati rate) kehte hain.

blocks.title: Average rate
blocks.text: Average rate (ausat rate) do khaas waqton ke darmiyan reaction ki rate hai, yani poore waqfe par rate.
Kisi bhi waqfe mein average aur instantaneous rate sirf ek lamhe par barabar hoti hain. Shuru mein instantaneous rate average se zyada hoti hai, aur waqfe ke aakhir mein average se kam.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 7.1
blocks.problem: Haber process mein ammonia banne ka reaction: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g). i. 1.0 min ke baad instantaneous rate nikalein. ii. 1.0 aur 4.0 minute ke darmiyan ammonia banne ki average rate kya hai, jab ammonia ki concentration 1.0 min par 3.5 mol dm⁻³ aur 4.0 min par 6.2 mol dm⁻³ hai?
steps: i. Instantaneous rate ke liye 1.0 min par concentration-time curve ka tangent (chhoone wali seedhi line) kheench kar us ka slope chahiye. Kitab yeh graph nahi deti, is liye yeh number is data se nahi nikalta.
ii. ΔC = Δ[NH₃] = (6.2 − 3.5) mol dm⁻³ = 2.7 mol dm⁻³
Rate of formation of NH₃ = ΔC/Δt = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ / 3.0 min = 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹
blocks.answer: 1.0 se 4.0 min ke darmiyan NH₃ banne ki average rate 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne nitrogen ko N₂(aq) likha hai; Haber process mein nitrogen gas hai: N₂(g). Kitab ne 1.0 min par instantaneous rate = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ / 1 min = 2.7 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ likha hai. Yeh sahi nahi: 2.7 mol dm⁻³ to 1.0 se 4.0 min ke darmiyan ki tabdeeli hai; ise 1 min se divide karna na instantaneous rate deta hai na average. Aakhri line mein unit ke minus ke nishan reh gaye hain (mol dm³ min¹); sahi unit mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ hai.

blocks.prompt: Hydrogen aur iodine se hydrogen iodide banta hai: H₂(g) + I₂(g) → 2HI(g). Reaction shuru hone ke 100.0 s baad iodine ki concentration 0.010 mol dm⁻³ se gir kar 0.0080 mol dm⁻³ ho gayi. Is waqfe mein average rate kya hai?

items: Instantaneous rate: ek lamhe ki rate (tangent ka slope); average rate: poore waqfe par tabdeeli / waqt.
Haber misal: 3.0 min mein 2.7 mol dm⁻³, average rate 0.90 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹.
